about: measure contests of 2024 in West Virginia, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2024 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/NYTPDU, version 1.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2024-wv-precinct-general.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

question.title: Amendment No.1: Protection Of Persons Against Medically Assisted Suicide

threshold.rule: Majority of qualified voters voting on the question
threshold.quote: If a majority of the qualified voters, voting on the question at the polls held pursuant to such law, ratify the proposed amendment, it shall be in force from the time of such ratification, as part of the constitution of the state.
threshold.matched: by the type the source's title states (amendment)

p.under: the model's own (D3-v1.1), like past measures
p.note: this route's back-test of statewide measures shows more near-even finishes than it forecast (11 against 6.8 within 1 point of ½, and 10 against 6.2 within 20,000 votes, 2018 to 2024), so p may be low
